description_en: Collects a single public web page into the enterprise knowledge base of the current user
description_zh: 采集单个公开网页到当前用户的企业知识库
kebab_example: aliyun winnexo create-knowledge-base-public-url --original-url https://example.com --directory-id dir_tenant_child --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateKnowledgeBasePublicUrl

parameters.help_en: The platform application token issued by the console. If specified, the operation is performed as the user specified by opsUserId or opsUserCode
parameters.help_zh: 平台应用 Token（控制台签发）。传入后将以 opsUserId 或 opsUserCode 指定的用户身份执行
parameters.name: app_token

parameters.help_en: The proxy user ID, which is the WINNEXO platform user ID. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as winnexo_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户ID（WINNEXO 平台用户ID），仅当应用凭证配置为 winnexo_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_id

parameters.help_en: The proxy user code, which is unique within the tenant. This parameter is used only when the application credential is configured as source_uid
parameters.help_zh: 代理用户编码（租户内唯一），仅当应用凭证配置为 source_uid 时使用
parameters.name: ops_user_code

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. This is a common parameter. If not specified, the default tenant of the caller is used
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，公共参数；缺省时使用调用方默认租户
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The URL of the public HTTP or HTTPS web page
parameters.help_zh: 公开 HTTP/HTTPS 网页 URL
parameters.name: original_url

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource. If not specified, the URL is used
parameters.help_zh: 资源名称；省略时使用 URL
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the target folder in the enterprise knowledge base. This parameter is required, and you must have knowledge base management permissions on the knowledge base
parameters.help_zh: 目标企业知识库目录 ID；必填，必须具备该知识库管理权限
parameters.name: directory_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the operating object
parameters.name: operating_object_name

parameters.help_en: The list of resource tags in JSON string format
parameters.help_zh: 资源标签 JSON 字符串列表
parameters.name: source_tags

200.description_en: 采集公开网页到企业知识库
200.description_zh: 采集公开网页到企业知识库

schema.description_en: The response schema for collecting a public web page into the enterprise knowledge base
schema.description_zh: 采集公开网页到企业知识库

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of 200 indicates success

directoryId.description_en: The ID of the requested target directory in the enterprise knowledge base
directoryId.description_zh: 实际请求的企业知识库目标目录 ID

gmtCreate.description_en: The creation time in ISO 8601 format

message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is empty if the request is successful

originalUrl.description_en: The URL of the submitted public web page
originalUrl.description_zh: 已提交的公开网页 URL

scope.description_en: The scope of the resource. The value is fixed to TENANT

sourceId.description_en: The ID of the newly created source

status.description_en: The status of the resource. A value of RUNNING indicates that the request is accepted but the crawling and parsing are not completed
status.description_zh: 资源状态；RUNNING 表示已受理，尚未完成抓取和解析
